subject: Step-up plan and QBR slot availability — Stormbridge renewal
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@stormbridge.com>, Katherine Mills <katherine.mills@stormbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Step-up plan and QBR slot availability — Stormbridge renewal

Hi Liam / Katherine,

Hope you both are well — it's renewal season for Stormbridge (deal SBX-4237) and we'd like to kick off a short mutual action plan to lock term adjustments, capacity, and a QBR date. High-level asks in this first note:

- Confirm target contract term and preferred uplift (12/24 months + committed throughput vs capacity burst window).
- Share procurement contact (if different from procurement@stormbridge.com).
- Pick 2 preferred QBR slots (week of Jul 25 preferred) via the poll below.

I've attached a short step-up plan and a proposed_terms_v1 doc for your review. Suggested timeline: 30-day cadence — terms & PO in two weeks, capacity validation + workshop within three weeks, QBR in week of Jul 25. If that works, we'll schedule a 60-minute capacity workshop (SE + CS) to go over utilization, burst windows, and runbook for scaling.

Quick context on the uplift options: we can do a committed throughput uplift (tokens/sec / concurrency) or a blended seat + throughput model. For forecasting the uplift, a short pre-workshop spreadsheet (attached) will help — please forward to whoever owns monthly usage and procurement.

Next steps:
1) Please indicate procurement contact and preferred term (12 vs 24).
2) Pick QBR preferences here: https://doodle.com/poll/renewal-stormbridge-qbr-2028
3) We'll send a capacity workshop invite once you pick slots.

Attachments: SBX-4237_step-up-plan_v1.pdf, SBX-4237_proposed_terms_v1.docx

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@stormbridge.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Katherine Mills <katherine.mills@stormbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Step-up plan and QBR slot availability — Stormbridge renewal

Thanks Avery — appreciate the clear framing. A couple quick notes:

- Stormbridge is interested in a 12->24 month step-up (commit to higher throughput with a 12-mo trial, auto-extend to 24 on acceptance). We need an outline of the rollback / exit terms if the throughput profile isn't met.
- Procurement contact is procurement@stormbridge.com (I'll cc them separately).
- Our usage has regular daily spikes (5–6 hours) and two monthly large batch windows — we need to ensure burst capacity covers those windows without throttling.

QBR timing: week of Jul 25 works. Afternoon PST is ideal (we prefer 1pm or 3pm PT). I've filled out the poll with those slots.

Also: could you attach SOC 2 Type II and your latest pen test summary for our security team? Procurement will request those during contract review.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Step-up plan and QBR slot availability — Stormbridge renewal

Thanks Liam — copying procurement as requested. A couple internal items from our side:

- Ben (SE) and Monica (CS) will run a 45-minute capacity review. Ben: can you propose two windows next week (PST late morning / early afternoon) that line up with Stormbridge availability?
- I uploaded a short prep template (capacity_template.xlsx) to the shared drive — please fill top-line utilisation numbers before the workshop so we can surface sizing options. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/SBX-4237/renewal-prep
- Avery: I'll prepare a short contract note with an explicit rollback clause and staging acceptance criteria for throughput targets.

Action items and owners:
- Stormbridge: fill capacity_template.xlsx (owner: Liam) — due EOD Thu Jul 12.
- Redwood SE/CS: schedule capacity workshop — owner: Ben.
- Redwood AE: circulate contract note & updated proposed_terms_v2 — owner: Avery — target Jul 16.

I'll also schedule a 30-minute pre-QBR sync with us (internal) the day before the QBR to align talking points and the executive readout.

Thanks all — Marissa

Hi Liam — Ben here (Sales Engineer). I'll run the capacity review and workshop. Two proposed slots that match your afternoon preference:

- Tue Jul 16, 2028 1:00pm PT (45 minutes)
- Wed Jul 17, 2028 3:00pm PT (45 minutes)

I created a short Doodle to sync on final timing: https://doodle.com/poll/renewal-stormbridge-qbr-2028
(you should already see your picks — thanks!)

For the workshop prep: please populate the capacity_template.xlsx with the last 90 days of peak hourly usage and the two monthly batch windows (start/end + estimated tokens). If you can also provide the contact for the team that manages the batch jobs, that will help us recommend the correct burst profile.

Attachments: capacity_template.xlsx (also on Drive)

Looking forward to it — Ben
